target_name: Reinvestment Discipline In Both Valuation Tails
rationale: The two-sided gate is internally consistent (both indicators evaluate correctly, and the asset-growth anomaly predicts the same sign in the glamour tail), and it is a genuine diagnostic rather than a percentile nudge, though it risks diluting the archive's alpha by pooling cheap and expensive low-capex firms into the same extreme deciles with a large zero mass in the middle.

target_name: Dual Channel Discipline Fixed Plus Working Capital
rationale: This is a mechanical rank-blend of two already-evaluated archive signals with no new economic content, and it is technically fragile because the gated capx component is exactly zero for 70% of firms, so its rank contribution is a giant tie block that will dominate the sum and mostly reproduce the inventory signal.

target_name: Replacement Cost Cheapness With Reinvestment Restraint
rationale: Swapping the valuation anchor from book equity to gross installed plant is a substantive change that produces a low-q-on-capacity gate rather than a repackaged HML long leg, though the gate will load heavily on capital-intensive industries and is partly mechanically related to the capx/ppent discriminator, so industry neutralization would be the natural next refinement.

The utilization-versus-spending distinction is economically real and not covered by the archive's level and change-in-level capex signals, but the discriminator is essentially the change in asset turnover (Soliman's DuPont decomposition, a published predictor) and can rise mechanically from divestitures rather than sweating assets, so the result will need a disposal control to be interpretable.

The discriminator is the well-documented hiring-rate/employment-growth anomaly (Bazdresch-Belo-Lin, Belo-Lin-Bazdresch), so the proposal is that known factor conditioned on value rather than a new mechanism, and the emp field is annual, frequently stale and rounded, which will inject noise into precisely the asset-light firms the design is meant to reach.

The proposal itself concedes the economic content is identical to the archive's best signal and only the gate-versus-weight encoding changes, which is the definition of a cosmetic variant; worse, multiplying a signed z-score by a strictly positive rank makes the composite a capex-discipline signal with an amplitude tilt rather than a value-investment interaction, so it cannot cleanly test the stated mechanism.
